_about: Nuclear weapons which are deployed or in active stockpiles (as of the 2025-2026 sources below), for the fallout simulator.  No retired or historical weapons.  Every yield is quoted from its source.
_rules: yield_kt is the most recent source's single figure; where the sources give only a range, or disagree, it is the top of it (the case with the most fallout).  yield_range_kt is the range the sources give.
Variable-yield weapons have one entry for each setting a source gives.

No public source gives the fission share of any warhead.  fission_fraction is assumed, as Glasstone and Dolan (1977, 9.94) plan for: 0.5 for a two-stage thermonuclear weapon (most derive at least half their yield from fission), 1.0 for a fission or boosted-fission weapon, and for the W76-2, which the source says uses only its fission primary.
Weapons whose yield no source gives are left out (see _omitted).

sources.SIPRI26: SIPRI Yearbook 2026, chapter 8, World nuclear forces, Tables 8A.2-8A.10 (data as of January 2026). https://www.sipri.org/sites/default/files/YB26%2008%20World%20Nuclear%20Forces.pdf
